reason: The plugin is a workflow automation and orchestration tool centered on PRD production. Based on the repository description, README, and package metadata, its user-facing role is to connect requirement-management stages in DeepSeek Harness with `ai_pm_*` model tools and a GUI dashboard while enforcing a human confirmation checkpoint.

summaries.zh: DSH AI-PM 是一款面向 DeepSeek Harness 的产品需求管理插件，用于接入 PRD 流程、推动需求条目分阶段生成与校验，并在 Web 看板中通过人工确认闸门提交最终产物。
summaries.en: DSH AI-PM is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for PRD workflow orchestration, providing requirement pipeline operations and a web board flow with manual human confirmation gates before finalizing work items.

capabilities: Initialize and track requirement workspaces through a PRD pipeline
Run staged PRD workflow steps via model-accessible tools (init/status/entry/gate/reflow/skill/artifact)
Provide human-review gates for confirmation before final artifact state changes
Generate and validate structured requirement artifacts and stage transitions
